protocol.primary_rule: all normal trials safe; >=90% recover and complete; normal angle beats every control in >=90%; normal contact beats >=3/4 controls in >=90%

limitations: Reduced six-joint actuator/support surrogate, not FlyGym, muscles or a complete free-standing fly body.
Contact objective is an engineered geometric proxy, not collision force.
Controls perturb the decoded engineered state; no natural vision or novel action invention.
Functional surrogate validation cannot establish biological mirror neurons.
